items.text: Pokémon Center: free healing, PP included. We saved here.
Poké Mart: Poké Ball ¥200, Potion ¥300, Antidote ¥100, Parlyz Heal ¥200, Awakening ¥250, Burn Heal ¥250, Escape Rope ¥550, Repel ¥350.
Pewter Gym, door at (15,16). Camper Liam, then Brock.
The Gym guide's trigger: tiles (42,21-23) and (43,23). It repeats until Brock is beaten.
The scientist: gives the Card Case once Brock is beaten.
